blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre um projeto de pesquisa a partir de uma palestra, usando refrain from, frases clivadas e fall through.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Lecture: Why Research Projects Fall Through
paras: Good morning. Many projects **fall through** not because the idea is weak, but because the plan is. **It is poor communication that** most often derails teams. Researchers should **refrain from promising** more than they can deliver.
**Hardly ever do** deadlines survive without buffers. **Had** the team **built** in slack, the study **would not have collapsed**. **Should** you foresee delays, **say so early**.

items.q: Projects fall through because ideas are weak.
items.why: not because the idea is weak.

items.q: Researchers should promise more than they can deliver.

Exemplo

blocks.body: **fall through** = não se concretizar (planos, acordos, projetos). Sinônimos: **collapse, fail, come to nothing**.

items.s: It is poor communication ___ derails teams. (that)
Researchers should refrain from ___ too much. (promise -ing)
Hardly ever ___ deadlines survive without buffers. (do)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: O que os pesquisadores devem evitar?

items.ans: Why do research projects fall through
items.pt: Por que projetos de pesquisa fracassam?

body: **Come to nothing.** — Dar em nada.
**Go down the drain.** — Ir por água abaixo.
**Back to square one.** — De volta à estaca zero.
**Drop the ball.** — Deixar a bola cair.
**Miss the mark.** — Errar o alvo.
**Salvage something.** — Salvar algo.
**Bite off more than one can chew.** — Dar um passo maior que a perna.
**Learn the hard way.** — Aprender na marra.
**Why do research projects fall through?** — Por que projetos de pesquisa fracassam?
**What should researchers avoid?** — O que os pesquisadores devem evitar?
**They should refrain from promising too much.** — Devem evitar prometer demais.

head: Phrasal verb
Significado
Exemplo
rows: The plan fell through. — O plano não se concretizou.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

blocks.task: Write a 90-word lecture summary on why projects fall through, using fall through, a cleft and refrain from.
blocks.model: Projects fall through not because the idea is weak, but because the plan is. It is poor communication that most often derails teams. Researchers should refrain from promising more than they can deliver. Hardly ever do deadlines survive without buffers. Had the team built in slack, the study would not have collapsed. Should you foresee delays, say so early.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
